execution_mode: paper fill at the close of the first eligible official session, with queue-data limitation
decision_rule: Pin one P1 rank-1 candidate from the specified ranking snapshot at the recorded decision time. This paper decision is not an O00 decision.
eligible_session_rule: The first officially evidenced equity-market session whose local session date is after the recorded decision date. Do not infer or synthesize a session date.
execution_price_rule: Candidate official TSETMC daily pClosing in IRR from that first eligible session only. A later session price cannot substitute for it.
execution_label: اجرای فرضی با محدودیت دادهٔ صف؛ دادهٔ روزانه صف، اولویت سفارش یا fill واقعی را اثبات نمی‌کند.
quantity_rule: Integer shares; lot is one share; shares = floor(available_cash_toman / (close_rial / 10 * (1 + 0.005))). Reduce by one share if rounded accounting would exceed cash.
fee_disclaimer: Proxy فرض آزمایشی برای هر سمت است؛ تعرفه، مالیات یا هزینهٔ واقعی بازار نیست.
non_execution_rule: No eligible official session, no candidate quote for that exact first eligible session, non-positive volume/close, identity mismatch, unresolved corporate action, or insufficient cash for one share means no fill and cash remains unchanged.
expiry_rule: Keep the paper order pending for correction/evidence of the designated first-session close; expire it at the close of the third officially evidenced equity-market session after decision if no eligible fill record exists. No later session close may replace the designated first-session price.
duplicate_rule: One immutable order_id per decision_id. Apply at most one fill; replay with the same source hashes is idempotent. A different fill or source revision requires an append-only correction event, never a second debit.
accounting_rule: Debit gross cost plus the assumed fee once; shares times purchase price is asset cost; mark-to-market begins only after a recorded paper fill. Before fill, P/L remains zero.
queue_data: Unavailable in daily close data; show the limitation alongside any fill.
